invariants.rationale: The method always returns Collections.emptyList(), which is never null.
Collections.emptyList() always returns an empty list, so result must be empty.
If the list is empty, its size is 0.
Collections.emptyList() returns an instance of List.
If result supports RandomAccess, it is still empty, so get(0) would throw or be null depending on impl; here we constrain via emptiness.
